comparison.objective: Open a piano lid while installing its support prop; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR continuously supports a loaded lid with one arm while the other swings and seats a prop. Candidate uses a fine hex tool and collar, then performs hands-clear test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the lid resting on its prop without a drop. Candidate requires two safe repeatable axial stops and ≤2° collar drift. PR lacks a separate spec.
comparison.reason: Support transfer and prop insertion test different mechanics and outcomes from damper adjustment and commissioning.
